notes.title: 2025 Publisher Sale
notes.notes:
[h3]Today kicks off the big [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/2LeftThumbs2025][b]2 Left Thumbs[/b] Publisher Sale[/url]![/h3]
Explore the full event page to scope out loads of discounts, free games, bundles and more!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/2LeftThumbs2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39217323/c11f237f089d5f895f0e8ba5921ebf80e931d8ee.png[/img][/url]

[h2]How about a FREE game?![/h2]
[b]Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre[/b] launched TODAY, and is available [u]100% for free[/u]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997920/Croak_Crusader_Spawn_of_the_Spore_Spectre/

This free title introduces the general gameplay, protagonist and antagonists of the upcoming (paid) release, [b]Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada[/b]. Be sure to add that to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3152060/Croak_Crusader_the_Champion_of_Canada/

[h2]COMING SOON[/h2]
Very VERY soon! [b]Novus Orbis[/b] is a combo-based roguelike deckbuilder, set to release into Early Access on [b]February 10th[/b]. There's already dozens of hours of content, and the game will only be getting deeper and more varied from here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437330/Novus_Orbis/

[h2]NEW UPDATES[/h2]
A collection of games have all timed free updates and big announcements for this event!

[h3]WizardChess[/h3]
[b]WizardChess[/b] is a chess-like tactical roguelike with a near infinitely replayable amount of variety and depth. And today takes us a step closer to FULLY infinite replayability, with the addition of Daily Runs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274210/WizardChess/

[h3]Starground[/h3]
At the end of 2024 [b]Starground[/b] revealed a planned [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2793380/view/539966570464543216]development roadmap[/url]. Today sees the [i]Brewconomic Cropdate[/i], adding animals, fishing, potion brewing, and an improved Space Hub.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2793380/Starground/

[h3]Magenta Horizon[/h3]
In addition to making the awesome art for this sale, solo-dev Maddison Baek has crafted new community items for [b]Magenta Horizon[/b]! Play the game to earn Trading Cards, and unlock awesome profile backgrounds and other Steam goodies.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109060/Magenta_Horizon__Neverending_Harvest/

[h3]Schism[/h3]
[b]Schism[/b] has a new update dropping Feb 10th that adds some end-game content, and enhanced controller support. Keep your eyes peeled for that! But the BIG news here, is that Schism is leaving Early Access [u][b]MARCH 10th[/b][/u]!! [i]There is no discount now, so as not to conflict with that launch discount[/i].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084300/Schism/

[h3]Tower of Kalemonvo[/h3]
While this classic-style hack n slash ARPG isn't out yet, it did just receive yet another demo update. The name of the game right now is [i]polish[/i], preparing for our newly set released date of [u][b]MARCH 28th[/b][/u]!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351860/Tower_of_Kalemonvo/
